integrationHealth.description: Health of recorded, nonremoved connections, including disconnected feeds. Replacement rows for the same Plaid item or named provider feed collapse to the newest row; separate Plaid items and unnamed connections remain distinct. Provider mapping coverage does not guarantee sync telemetry: push or manual integrations can have no sync runs and report UNKNOWN with null sync fields. An empty integration list reports NO_INTEGRATIONS.

category.description: Provider-based categories: BANKING = Plaid, Finicity, Mercury, Meow, Rho, SVB OFX; CREDIT_CARD = Brex, Ramp; PAYMENT_PROCESSOR = Stripe; PAYROLL = Central, Deel, Every, Finch, Gusto, HelloFranklin, Human, Rippling, TriNet; ACCOUNTING = QuickBooks; OTHER = Arlo, BillDotCom, Captable, Carta, DirectIngest, Expensify, SWorks, Salesforce, Slack, Synder, Zaprite. Categories describe the provider, not individual account types (including Plaid accounts).

errorCode.description: Safe connection or setup reason when available; raw provider messages are not exposed. USER_EPOCH_REQUIRED means the user must choose the import start date during the active setup window.

lastSyncAttemptAt.description: Start of the latest recorded sync attempt, not the last successful data ingestion.

lastSyncStatus.description: Status of the latest recorded sync; in-progress attempts older than three hours report FAILED.

status.description: DISCONNECTED requires action: a disconnected connection, an authentication error (LOGIN_REQUIRED, ACCESS_REVOKED, INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS, MFA_NOT_SUPPORTED, INVALID_MFA, ITEM_LOCKED), pending add-on payment, or active import start-date setup. Other connection errors and failed or warning syncs are TEMPORARY_OUTAGE. Without these conditions, no sync history is UNKNOWN; successful or in-progress syncs are OK. There is no freshness cutoff for successful syncs, so OK does not guarantee current data.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor on the next request, retaining include=integration_health; null ends pagination.
